model: image-only triage (AGT-img), trained to (nearly) 100 % training accuracy: answer when the image EF grade agrees with IMG-C3 and the EF estimate is far from every class cut

recipe.members: ECGFounder-f6 MLP heads (seeds 42/43/44) + linear distance-CE head (seed 42), each trained on all 837 until 100 % training accuracy (no selection split, no early stopping, as train100_features.py)
recipe.alpha: choose_alpha(protected) on the TRAIN100 IMG-vote outer OOF pooled over 3 repeats
recipe.ef: mean of ridge (alpha 1e-6) and LightGBM (4,000 trees, no early stopping), weights 1 / 0.3, fitted on all 837
recipe.cuts_and_threshold: floor-objective cuts and distance threshold (answered accuracy >= 0.70, >= 20 answered) on the pooled TRAIN100 outer OOF

training_accuracy.note: the frozen model on its own 837 training ECGs (training accuracy, not a performance estimate)

selection_data.note: computed on the same pooled OOF used to choose these values: optimistic, NOT a performance estimate

cv_expectation.source: TRAIN100 patient-grouped 5-fold CV x 3 repeats on the 837 development ECGs (train100/results/train100_features.json)
